column3: Close to the Hebrew; “Poplars” is rendered “willows.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Words of a song” is rendered “songs,” “mockers” as “tormentors,” and NASB adds “saying.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Ground of foreignness” is rendered “a foreign land.”
The Hebrew says only “may my right hand forget”; NASB adds “her skill.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Palate” is rendered “the roof of my mouth,” and “lift up” as “exalt.”
Close to the Hebrew; “To the people of Edom” is rendered “against the sons of Edom,” and “lay bare” as “Raze it.”
Close to the Hebrew; “About to be destroyed” is rendered “you devastated one.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Children” is rendered “little ones.”
